//: Emulator configuration for the Firestore migration proof.
The emulator is used because the migration service account has no Firestore
IAM in the real mydesckpro project, and because a throwaway emulator is the
right place to exercise rules and negative controls against production
collection names without any production data existing to endanger.
An emulator PASS is not authorization to cut over. It proves the rules and
the transforms; the real project still has to be proven separately.
